briefings.title: Chris Whalen: Why Double-Digit Inflation Is Possible, 30-Year Tops 5%

people.name: Julia La Roche
people.role: Host, The Julia La Roche Show

briefings.tldr: Chris Whalen warns that double-digit inflation is possible by year-end due to energy shortages and Middle East conflict, while the Federal Reserve prepares for a tectonic shift under Kevin Warsh toward a supply-side, market-driven policy regime.

briefings.title: Michael Howell: We Are Coming To An Inflection Point — Where Liquidity Is Headed

people.name: Julia La Roche
people.role: Host, The Julia La Roche Show

briefings.tldr: Global liquidity has peaked and is entering a multi-year "downswing" that likely won't bottom until 2027, driven by a "debt-refinancing wall" and a robust real economy that is draining capital away from financial markets.

briefings.title: Louis Gave: $120 Oil Breaks Everything — And Nobody Is Ready

people.name: Julia La Roche
people.role: Host, The Julia La Roche Show

briefings.tldr: Louis Gave argues that the global economy has entered a structurally inflationary regime where energy prices serve as the primary risk and essential equity hedge, rendering the traditional 60/40 portfolio obsolete.
